Phase-21.NAME: WebChatAttachments
Phase-21.purpose: Implement real file and image attachments in MAGRA web chat composer, separate from @-mentions, with session-safe storage and staged multimodal rollout.

steps.step-1: Separate attachment UX from @-mention insertion in dashboard composer and drag-drop handlers.
steps.step-2: Add attachment chips, image previews, remove actions, and validation state to web composer.
steps.step-3: Add attachment upload/register transport so chat submit sends text plus structured attachment refs.
steps.step-4: Implement bounded text extract plus reference semantics for attached text/code files and ref-only handling for binary files.
steps.step-5: Persist attachment metadata in sessions without embedding raw binary payloads in JSONL transcripts.
steps.step-6: Implement Wave-B image payload mapping so live image attachments become provider multimodal content parts while replay stays metadata-only.
steps.step-7: Verify attachment UI, API, replay, compatibility with plain-text sends, and current image-send gating boundary.
